scope: All eight original exposed development clips, unchanged original criteria, exact raw outputs. Read-only review with no additional model or frontend inference and no human audio-listening claim.

classification_definitions.acceptable: No material content error observed; accepted punctuation, contraction or spelling conventions may differ.
classification_definitions.minor_issue: A limited word, spelling, grammar or precision problem needs correction while the central proposition remains recoverable.
classification_definitions.major_error: A proper name, proposition, semantic relationship or substantial content is incorrectly recognized.
classification_definitions.not_evaluable: No completed aligned transcript is available.

material_findings: The fairness clause is restored, changing that case from major error to acceptable.
Three people, the collision/concession, Μαρτελί and Lakkha/bhajans remain incorrect or omitted.
The product name changes from Number One to Nummer One, a new material defect under the same original name-preservation rule; κύρια is also lost.
The two clear English outputs retain meaning; a spelling convention change does not establish a quality improvement.
comparison_limits: The original int8 and this diagnostic use the same eight full arrays, weights, decoder, thread counts and criteria, with only the predeclared frontend adapter changed. These observations establish frontend sensitivity, not which frontend matches training.
Completed Small VAD-off and Turbo outputs are comparison context only: those runs used explicit source language and app routes unlike this recognizer-only auto-language run.
Token times are native emission frames, not independently verified word boundaries or invented word ends.
Full-array binding covers the originally declared signed-16-bit decode conversion from the float32 WAVs; it does not claim the prepared PCM is byte-identical to the original WAV float32 payload.
Sampled process-group RSS and worker high-water measurements do not establish whole-machine consumption or an unsampled group peak.
No app upload, storage, export, restart, full-film or fresh-validation route was exercised.
decision: Reject this frontend diagnostic as an adoption candidate. A real local recovery coexists with persistent material errors and a new name error. Do not prefer the legacy frontend as ground truth, weaken criteria, or infer a quantization-only cause from this result.
